tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report a maintenance or repair problem in the unit, like a leak, a broken appliance, or no hot water.

tools.name: request_cleaning
tools.description: Request housekeeping: a cleaning, fresh towels, or new linens.

tools.name: extend_checkout
tools.description: Request a later checkout time than the standard one.

tools.name: book_taxi
tools.description: Book a taxi, cab, or airport transfer for the guest.

tools.name: set_ac_temperature
tools.description: Set the air conditioning temperature in the apartment.

tools.name: order_supplies
tools.description: Order more supplies for the guest, such as coffee, water, or toiletries.
